answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a lotus emerging from deep waters, identity is tied to economic skin-in-the-game. A ripple of malicious activity across the network causes the attacker to lose their staked assets, effectively drying up the river of their malicious influence. The cost of an attack is strictly proportional to the capital required to acquire a dominant stake in the consensus protocol.
